items.t: Hey, how's it going?
Long time no see! How have you been?
I'm doing pretty well, thanks for asking.
What have you been up to lately?
Nice to finally meet you in person.
items.z: 很高兴终于见到你本人了。

items.t: It was great catching up with you.
I'd better get going. Talk to you later!
Have a good one!
Take care, and say hi to your family for me.
items.z: 保重，替我向你家人问好。

items.t: How was your weekend?
Not much, just taking it easy.
items.z: 没什么特别的，就是放松一下。

items.t: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
items.z: 抱歉，我没听清你的名字。

items.t: Where are you from originally?
What do you do for a living?
Small world! I went to the same school.
items.z: 世界真小！我也上的那所学校。

items.t: Let's grab coffee sometime.
I'll text you and we can figure out a time.
items.z: 我给你发消息，我们再定时间。

items.t: It's been a crazy week.
Can't complain. Same old, same old.
Anyway, I should let you go.
